corpus_crossquery.query: Does the hedge erosion recorded in DL-METH-091 hold when the same authors restate the same work in a different venue?
corpus_crossquery.finding: 🔴 NO — AND THE FALSIFICATION IS SHARPER THAN THE ORIGINAL CLAIM. DL-METH-091 said a commentary by authors on their own paper is not a summary, because modality degrades. This is a review by the same laboratory on its own primary study, and the running text hedges PROPERLY throughout: 'Our recent study SUGGESTS new mechanisms', 'The first mechanism WE PROPOSE', 'it is POSSIBLE TO SPECULATE', 'is STILL TO BE INVESTIGATED', 'this is YET TO BE SHOWN'. Authorship therefore does not predict erosion. WHAT DOES, on the evidence of both papers, is the MODEL FIGURE. Here the running text that introduces Figure 1 hedges three times in two sentences, and the figure caption directly below states the same three mechanisms flatly — 'WWOX modulates ER expression and function, which in turn positively or negatively affects p53' — with no modal at all, and the drawing carries no dashed line, no question mark and no 'proposed' anywhere. The comparison is INTERNAL: same authors, same year, same venue, same paragraph. That controls for everything the venue-based explanation would need. 🔴 AND THE SECOND HALF REPLICATES PMID 27308504 EXACTLY: the one place this figure DOES hedge is ER→p53, drawn as two opposing arrows simultaneously because the authors have no directional claim there — precisely as 27308504's only hedge was a '?' on the MRN complex, the one element that was not its authors' claim. Two independent papers, same laboratory, same asymmetry: the figure marks uncertainty where the authors have no stake and states flatly where they do.

entries.proposition: WHAT THIS DOCUMENT IS, established before anything is drawn from it. A review, by the authors, of their own primary study — the same structural relationship PMID 27308504 has to PMID 25331887. No Methods, no Results, no Discussion section exists in the body; the empirical content is entirely restatement, and ref 10 (Cell Death Dis 2018) is cited fourteen times.

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE HEDGED SENTENCE, AND IT IS THE CONTROL THAT FALSIFIES MY OWN GENERALISATION. DL-METH-091 concluded that authors restating their own work state it more firmly. Here the same laboratory, restating the same work, hedges properly and repeatedly. The verb is 'suggests', the mechanism is 'proposed', and the inference is marked 'possible to speculate' — three hedges in two consecutive sentences, on the exact claim the figure below then states flat.

entries.proposition: 🔴 PANEL SIDE, QUALIFYING — AND THIS IS WHERE THE HEDGE DIES, INSIDE A PAPER THAT HEDGES CORRECTLY EVERYWHERE ELSE. The caption and the drawing state the three mechanisms as facts. No modal, no 'proposed', no dashed line, no question mark, no 'model' anywhere in the drawing's own lettering. The comparison is INTERNAL — same authors, same year, same venue, same paragraph — which controls for everything an explanation based on venue or on authorship would need. What the figure does hedge is the one thing the authors have no directional claim about: ER→p53 is drawn as TWO OPPOSING ARROWS SIMULTANEOUSLY, an inhibition and an activation from the same box to the same box, matching the caption's 'positively or negatively'. That is the exact asymmetry recorded on PMID 27308504, where the only hedge in the whole figure was a question mark on MRN — the one element that was not its authors' claim. Two papers, one laboratory, same rule: the figure marks uncertainty where the authors have no stake, and states flatly where they do.

entries.proposition: THE ATM CHAIN AGAIN, AND IT IS THE THIRD DOCUMENT IN THIS CORPUS TO CARRY IT. Stated flatly and cited to ref 22 = PMID 25331887, which this corpus has read completely. The verb here is 'enhances its activation' — firmer than Santini's 'putative' and Abu-Odeh's 'regulates', softer than Hazan's 'phosphorylates'. It belongs in the chain of DL-METH-093, and unlike Hazan it KEEPS ITS CITATION, which is the difference that matters.

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE ONE FACT IN THIS REVIEW THAT BEARS DIRECTLY ON THE REFERENCE GENOTYPE, and it is the opposite of the transfer flagged on PMID 27308504. There the schematic printed WWOX(+/-) on evidence that was entirely knockdown and null, with no heterozygous system anywhere in the primary. HERE A HETEROZYGOUS SYSTEM IS NAMED AND MEASURED: aged germline Wwox-heterozygous mice, on a mammary-susceptible C3H background, at about 50% penetrance. Recorded because it is the first heterozygous phenotype this corpus has anchored, and because the boundary conditions are as important as the number — the tumours are mammary, the background is chosen for mammary susceptibility, and the animals are aged. It is a cancer phenotype in a sensitised strain, not a statement about carriers of a neurodevelopmental genotype, and it must not be transferred as one.

verbatim_locators.note: COVERAGE IS COMPLETE FOR WHAT THIS DOCUMENT CONTAINS. Abstract, Introduction, all four thematic sections, the conclusions section, the figure caption and the 120-item reference list read in sequence from the PMC HTML; the single figure inspected at its deposited resolution. There are no Methods, Results or Discussion sections — checked, not assumed: the strings do not occur as headings. No tables and no supplementary material — likewise checked. 🔴 WHAT THIS READING IS NOT: this is a REVIEW and it contains no primary data. Its value here is not evidential but comparative — it is the control that falsifies the authorship-based explanation of DL-METH-091 and localises the erosion to the model figure. The primary study it reviews, Cell Death Dis 2018;9(8):832, is NOT read, and until it is, nothing here may be promoted as evidence for the WWOX-p53 axis.
